page.layout: One bookplate on the page: an engraved coat of arms with a prelate's hat and tassels, and a scroll-banner beneath it carrying the name. Blue and yellow library stamps and handwritten shelf marks lie over and below the plate.
page.notes: The engraving shows a coat of arms with a clerical hat and tassels, with stars, a chevron, a checkered field and a swan or duck in the base. Left out as not printed text: the blue stamp "9 / 4-c / 47", the yellow stamp "BIBLIOTECA NAZIONALE VITTORIO EMANUELE 9 / 6 B 47", the handwritten marks ("9 c", "4.1.79" and "9.4.c.47"), and the digitiser's "Digitized by Google" line.
